title: Supported Configurations - per-format UI config
description:
Schema for files under apps/mcu/assets/configs/supported_configurations/*.json.
Each top-level key is a format identifier or a conditional trigger key. Each key's value is an array of configuration objects.

name.description: Internal unique key / translation key used as the identifier for this control.

label.description: Translation key for the control label (user-facing). May be empty.

description.description: Translation key for help text / description.

is_visible.description: UI hint whether control is shown by default.

should_add_to_args.description: Whether the selected value(s) for this control should be emitted into ffmpeg args.

ffmpeg_flag.description: A flag to prefix option values with (e.g. '-b:a'). If null, options must provide full args via 'ffmpeg_arg' or full-valued 'value'.

default.description: Default selection. For single selection this is a string. For multi_choice it may be a JSON-stringified array or an actual array.

options.description: List of selectable options (not required for all control types, but commonly present).

optionObject.description: An option for a choice-style control.

label.description: Translation key for the option label. May be empty for hidden/internal options.

value.description: A value that either combines with parent's ffmpeg_flag or represents a full ffmpeg arg or a trigger key (matching a top-level key).

ffmpeg_arg.description: When present, this full string is emitted into ffmpeg args directly (used when parent.ffmpeg_flag is null or option needs to provide full argument).

description.description: Translation key for option-specific help text.
